Agenda #1: Approval of Annual Report and Financial Statements for the fiscal year ended 31 December 2025, including the audited financial statements with an unmodified opinion. Approved with 86.88% quorum and 95.87% votes in favor, granting full discharge to Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: Approval of the Use of Net Profit, including a cash dividend of Rp114,016,000,000 (Rp4 per share) for 28,504,000,000 shares, allocation of Rp5,000,000,000 to reserve funds, and the remainder retained as retained earnings. Approved with 97% votes in favor.
Agenda #3: Approval of the Appointment of a Public Accountant, authorizing the Board of Commissioners to appoint a public accounting firm for auditing the 2026 consolidated financial statements, with the Board of Directors setting the honorarium. Approved with 93.47% votes in favor.
Agenda #4: Approval of the Adjustment to Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI), authorizing the Board of Directors to execute the amendment and registrations. Approved with 83.64% votes in favor.
